title: A plastering payroll investigation brought $270,900 back to the state insurer

beats.text: A payroll investigation followed money reported to two state agencies.

visual.sub: Investigators traced two payroll reporting channels

beats.text: The prosecutor estimated approximately $5.8 million in unreported payroll.

visual.label: Investigators traced two payroll reporting channels

beats.text: Payroll affected both insurance premiums and tax contributions.

visual.kicker: Investigators traced two payroll reporting channels

beats.text: The City’s permit records identify two business names.

visual.kicker: City permit contacts distinguish the two businesses

beats.text: The plastering firm appears on 188 distinct building permits.
The other business appears as a contact on nine permits.

visual.kicker: City permit contacts distinguish the two businesses

beats.text: The public insurer received $270,900 in June 2024.

visual.label: The administrator paid $270,900 to the public insurer

beats.text: The prosecutor identified the payment during a second diversion petition.

visual.kicker: The administrator paid $270,900 to the public insurer

beats.text: The records do not identify a separate tax payment.
The court granted diversion over the prosecution’s opposition.

visual.kicker: The court dismissed the administrator’s charges

beats.text: Maher completed the program and the court dismissed her charges.
The prosecutor still listed warrants for the other defendants.

visual.kicker: The court dismissed the administrator’s charges
